title: Northline opens AI research centre in Gurugram
summary: A 400-seat research centre focused on applied machine learning opens in Gurugram, the company's third India facility.

title: Edge computing lab expands in Noida
summary: The Noida edge computing laboratory doubles its floor area to support sensor network deployments across northern India.

title: Northline funds robotics fellowship at Okhla campus
summary: A two-year fellowship programme for autonomous systems research begins at the company's Okhla campus.

title: New semiconductor design office opens in Santa Clara
summary: The Santa Clara office will host chip design and verification teams working on photonics interconnects.

title: Northline partners with Berkeley on climate modelling grant
summary: A joint research grant will fund climate modelling work on renewable grid integration.

title: Quantum software team established in SoMa
summary: A new team in SoMa will build compiler tooling for superconducting qubit hardware.
